# thegurucool.ai

> thegurucool.ai is an AI-powered platform that measures a teacher's AI competency, coaches them on a real task from their own classroom, and shows the growth.

thegurucool.ai offers AI-powered, competency-based professional development for teachers and educators in schools, colleges and institutions. We currently work in Malaysia, the Philippines, India and Singapore. More than 130 teachers are onboarded.

## How it works
- Diagnostic: a 140-question scenario-based diagnostic measures a teacher's AI competency across the seven domains of the TEACH-AI™ framework.
- Pathway: a personalised pathway adapts to the gaps the diagnostic found and to the teacher's own classroom.
- Coaching: short lessons with the Guru, a personal AI coach, each built around a real classroom task and ending with a classroom commitment and a short check.
- School data: school leaders see which teaching practices are changing across their teachers.

## Research base
TEACH-AI™ is built on Bloom's Taxonomy, TPACK, Universal Design for Learning and Hattie's Visible Learning, applied to AI-integrated classrooms.

## Pricing
thegurucool.ai is free for teachers. Schools can contact us for pricing.
